name: @tachikoma/desktop
description: The Tachikoma desktop shell: Electron supervisor over the local sidecar.

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && bun build src/main/main.ts --format=esm --target=node --external electron --outfile dist/main/main.js && bun build src/main/preload.ts --format=cjs --target=node --external electron --outfile dist/main/preload.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && bun build src/renderer/app.ts --outdir dist/renderer --target browser && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html
